question: Who among the following adopted the policy of consolidation in place of expansion by eliminating the rebels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghiyasuddin Balban**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ghiyasuddin Balban was the Sultan of Delhi from 1266 to 1287.
 
• He adopted a policy of consolidation by eliminating the rebels and maintaining strict control over his territories.
 
• Balban is known for his strong centralized administration and efforts to strengthen the Sultanate against internal and external threats.
 
• He implemented a policy of "blood and iron" to suppress revolts and rebellions, ensuring the stability and security of his rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shamsuddin Iltutmish**

 
 
• Iltutmish was the third Sultan of Delhi and a prominent ruler of the Mamluk dynasty.
 
• He is known for consolidating the Delhi Sultanate and introducing important administrative reforms.
 
• Iltutmish completed the construction of the Qutub Minar in Delhi.
 
• He introduced the silver tanka and the copper jital, standardizing the monetary system of the Sultanate.
 
 
 
• **Raziya**
 
 
• Raziya, also known as Razia Sultan, was the first and only female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• She ruled from 1236 to 1240 and was known for her administrative skills and efforts to promote gender equality.
 
• Raziya faced significant opposition from the nobility and was eventually overthrown.
 
 
 
• **Nasiruddin Mahmud**
 
 
• Nasiruddin Mahmud was the Sultan of Delhi from 1246 to 1266.
 
• He was a nominal ruler, with real power being held by his deputy, Ghiyasuddin Balban.
 
• Mahmud's reign is noted for the consolidation of the Sultanate's administration and military.
 
 
 
• **Ghiyasuddin Balban's Policies**
 
 
• Balban emphasized a strong and centralized administration to ensure the Sultanate's stability.
 
• He implemented a strict policy of law and order, using harsh measures to suppress rebellions and maintain control.
 
• Balban's reign marked the beginning of the consolidation of the Sultanate, setting the stage for future rulers.
